title: Stop Refereeing Every Sibling Fight | Parenting Rewind
description:
You hear shouting and rush in ready to decide who started it. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: You hear shouting and rush in ready to decide who started it. Choosing a villain before listening can intensify competition for your approval. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Check safety, separate for a pause if needed, then hear each child briefly and restate the shared rule. Be a calm boundary keeper, not a courtroom; older children can help propose a workable next step.

source.title: Sibling Relationships: How to Help Your Kids Build Healthy Bonds

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
